construction.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Caller
    participant Service
    participant Store
    Caller->>Service: Get item
    Service->>Store: Read item
    Store-->>Service: Item
    Service-->>Caller: Item

interpretation.author: agent
interpretation.intent: Expose the order of a delegated lookup and its replies without implying error handling or storage implementation.
rules: Participants are ordered Caller, Service, Store.
Messages follow the brief's four steps in top-to-bottom order.
Solid request arrows differ from dashed reply arrows.
Mermaid is construction state, not a second fence in the document.
